In this Sunday, July 25, 2017 photo, the shadows of two boys are seen on the side of a tent inside the Khazer camp for displaced people in Northern Iraq. A poem is written in the side of the tent: "Ask me who I am, I am talking for myself. I am the one who doesn't have a house or a home. I'm the one without relatives and a country. I used to have a house protecting me from the treason of time. In a moment this house collapsed and there's something left for me. I had to choose between the flames of war and the consequences of displacement. I chose displacement and the tent became my home." (AP Photo/Bram Janssen)
